review.rationale: The single-line diff wraps the reel.play() call in a prefers-reduced-motion check identical to the one already used elsewhere in the file. When reduced motion is enabled, autoplay is suppressed (criterion 0). The reelBtn click handler is untouched, so manual playback still works (criterion 1). When reduced motion is not enabled, the matchMedia condition is false and play() is called exactly as before (criterion 2). The change is minimal and focused; no other behavior is altered. All three acceptance criteria are satisfied and the automated tests confirm this.
